cells.gaps: The Côte d'Ivoire Identité app holds the ID card, but the app says the authorities do not yet recognise its digital ID, so no state-accepted mobile ID or wallet has been found; a national authentication platform and wallet are only at feasibility study.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 23 October 2026 that a method counts only where the state accepts it: the Côte d'Ivoire Identité app's digital ID is not recognised by the authorities, so it sets no rung. E-signature in use across the public administration on ANSSI's national PKI holds stage 4 (CIV-005, CIV-004, CIV-010).
